capabilities: Scan CSS files for setting definitions in /* @settings comments
Render settings as toggles, dropdowns, sliders, and color pickers in one pane
Toggle classes on and off the body element
Set text, number, and color CSS variables
Generate color gradients between two color variables
extras: Plugins that ship settings must call app.workspace.trigger("parse-style-settings") on load for their options to appear. Titles and descriptions support localization via language postfixes.
intentEvidence: This plugin allows snippet, theme, and plugin CSS files to define a set of configuration options.
problem: Obsidian gives no built-in way for theme, snippet, and plugin CSS files to offer users adjustable options; users would have to edit CSS by hand.
summary: Settings pane that exposes CSS variables and class toggles defined by themes, snippets, and plugins as user-adjustable controls.
